name: @kairotic/rhythm
description: Kairotic rhythm as geometry (after Toussaint): necklace, the rhythm box (a cyclic rhythm on the circle: drawn, edited, measured — interval vector, evenness, deep, flat, axes of symmetry, oddity, Fourier coefficients — and written as a musical tree whose :rtm merges with any pitches); and euclid, a generator of Euclidean rhythms as pulses
author: bonuoq
